source: Existing 42-trial reconstructed report; analysis uses 24 successful examples from four models and three conditions
two_poles: Mean active concentration in first and last 5% of domain each exceeds the minimum interior concentration by threshold times INITIAL full-profile contrast; thresholds 0.1, 0.25, 0.5; count intervals only when both sampled endpoints pass
half_height_width: Trapezoidal integral of initial concentration >= minimum + half initial contrast; nominal physical length, Spring native nominal units
limits: Chosen shortest passing pulses differ between lengths; trajectories are not matched-duration controls
Two-pole indicator is descriptive, not an eigenvalue or attractor analysis
Spring recovery samples every 2.5 native units; fast early changes have limited resolution
Scalar full-polarity success does not guarantee final complete-field stability
No model-specific saturation point is estimated
MCA and inhibitor traces establish association only
